segments.name: BioSymetrics
segments.description: Biomedical AI platform integrating genomics, imaging and electronic health records to advance biomarker discovery, therapeutic development and precision medicine.
segments.evidence: BioSymetrics is a biomedical artificial intelligence company focused on integrating multimodal data sources, including genomics, imaging, electronic health records, and other real-world evidence, to advance biomarker discovery, therapeutic development, and precision medicine.

segments.name: RENB
segments.description: Biotech developing allogeneic cell and gene therapies, subject to funding, to promote immune responses against solid tumors and serious infectious diseases.
segments.evidence: Renovaro Biosciences is a biotechnology company intending, if the necessary funding is obtained, to develop advanced allogeneic cell and gene therapies to promote stronger immune system responses potentially for long-term or life-long cancer remission in some of the deadliest cancers, and potentially to treat or cure serious infectious diseases such as Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) infections.

revenueModel.text: A single customer pays a fixed fee for research services, which the company recognizes ratably over the service period.
revenueModel.evidence: During the year ended June 30, 2026 the Company began providing research services under a fixed fee services agreement with a single customer.

changes.text: GEDi Cube filed for bankruptcy and ceased operations in the quarter ended September 2025.
changes.evidence: During the quarter ended September 30, 2025, GEDi Cube B.V. ("GEDi Cube"), acquired on February 13, 2024, filed for bankruptcy and ceased operations.
